candidate_claim: Catalogue-scale TESS QPP studies already exist.
safe_wording: Within the included BAII corpus, catalogue-scale TESS QPP analyses are represented by at least BAIIW0001 and BAIIW0003.
unsafe_wording: No catalogue-scale TESS QPP study existed before this project.
notes: This is a bounded corpus statement, not an exhaustive priority claim.

candidate_claim: TESS QPP catalog/classification work predates F3A.
safe_wording: The included literature contains TESS QPP catalogue and classification work published before the prospective F3A freeze.
unsafe_wording: F3A is the first TESS QPP catalogue/classification study.

candidate_claim: AFINO has already been applied at catalogue scale to TESS QPP analysis.
safe_wording: BAIIW0001 applies AFINO to a catalogue-scale sample of 20-second TESS flares.
unsafe_wording: This project introduces the first catalogue-scale AFINO analysis of TESS QPPs.
notes: The exact future F3A robustness contribution must be distinguished from catalogue-scale AFINO use itself.

candidate_claim: Machine-learning QPP classification has been applied to TESS catalogue data.
safe_wording: BAIIW0003 reports applying a previously published fully convolutional QPP classifier to a large TESS flare catalogue.
unsafe_wording: Machine-learning QPP classification has not previously been used on TESS catalogue data.
notes: Detailed classifier validation remains access-limited in BAII; only the supported high-level claim is used.

candidate_claim: Injection–recovery/selection-function approaches already exist in adjacent flare/QPP methodology.
safe_wording: The included BAII literature contains multiple injection–recovery, known-ground-truth and selection-function analogues relevant to future F3B design.
unsafe_wording: F3B would introduce injection–recovery or selection-function validation to flare/QPP methodology for the first time.
notes: These works are heterogeneous and do not all study QPPs or TESS.

candidate_claim: The audit found no included study with the complete prospective F3B development/held-out architecture.
safe_wording: No included BAII.4 work was assessed as matching the full project-specific combination of prospective development/validation separation and an independent held-out benchmark.
unsafe_wording: No previous study has ever used development/held-out validation for QPP detection.
notes: Absence is restricted to the 40 included works and the project-specific architecture.

candidate_claim: F3A would be the first catalogue-scale TESS QPP study.
safe_wording: Do not claim first catalogue-scale TESS QPP study; instead state the narrower robustness question actually addressed by the redesigned F3A.
unsafe_wording: F3A is the first catalogue-scale TESS QPP study.

candidate_claim: F3B would be the first QPP injection–recovery study.
safe_wording: Describe the project-specific validation architecture without claiming first QPP injection–recovery.
unsafe_wording: F3B is the first QPP injection–recovery study.
notes: BAIIW0098 uses synthetic known-truth QPP/non-QPP data and explicit validation; priority language is not authorized.

candidate_claim: No previous work studies robustness to methodological choices.
safe_wording: The literature contains multiple method-, processing-, window-, quality- and gap-related robustness considerations; F3A must state its specific robustness scope.
unsafe_wording: No prior work examined methodological robustness.
notes: The included works do not necessarily implement the same robustness grid as the project.

candidate_claim: This project is the first to study TESS QPP selection effects.
safe_wording: BAII does not establish a global priority claim about TESS QPP selection effects; any manuscript statement must be scoped to the project-specific design and audited corpus.
unsafe_wording: This is the first study of TESS QPP selection effects.
notes: The audit cannot convert non-retrieval of an exact precedent into absence from the literature.
